applicant.name: Dr. Jonas Leitner
applicant.organisation: Institute of Biomedical Informatics, Technical University (academic research)

purpose: We develop and validate a machine-learning model that predicts complications after hip fracture surgery in older patients. The model learns from each patient's sequence of diagnoses and hospital visits, which aggregated tables cannot provide.
question: Provide pseudonymised encounters and conditions of patients aged 65 or over who had an inpatient stay with a hip fracture as main diagnosis. Only model parameters and validation metrics will leave the secure environment.
definitions: Hip fracture stay = inpatient encounter with primary_icd10 starting with S72.
Cohort = patients aged 65 or over with at least one hip fracture stay.
Report the number of patients in the cohort.
